name: Soldier Twist
notes: The three.js examples' Soldier (a Mixamo rig) dances the Twist from the CMU motion capture library (subject 141, free for commercial use), retargeted by tools/make-dancer.mjs, then stands at ease (its own Idle) while the mystery box opens. The board rises on a stand beside him. Sources and the exact command: scenes/soldier-twist/source/. The printed card (scenes/soldier-twist/card.html) is an off-duty Twist dance-hall poster: camo stencil type, a 45 record, dog tags, a drill-manual page and boot prints.
